title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: 138. Notes media reports accusing the PfE Group of misusing at least EUR 171 644 in funds during the second half of 2024; notes that Parliament’s administration has requested clarification from the PfE Groupregarding the use of certain 2024 appropriations; emphasises that the PfE Group’s 2024 accounts received an unqualified opinion from the external auditor preselected by Parliament; indicates that the PfE Group has forwarded all the requested documentation to the DGFINS; notes that the discharge authority has not yet been informed but expects to be informed without delay of any further developments and of the outcome of the administrative follow-up in this matter;
